name: Mosaic KOT Ticket
describe: Kitchen order ticket: p12 r8 card, inner width 256, table/takeaway header, elapsed timer 24/32 mono (ltr), items at 12.5/600 with status pill and mono qty.

Mosaic KOT board (masonry grid). Colour by type: dine-in panel, takeaway blue, modified amber, cancelled red. Timer and qty stay ltr in Arabic. The source sets an inline border-color of --hair2 on every card that overrides the colour class border; this mock follows the class list (--ac-b, --am-b, --rd-b). Modes: light and rtl only; dark is not applicable (mosaic/src/index.css defines one light palette (:root only) and no dark: classes or .dark overrides, so the KDS has no dark theme).
